notes: BackOtter's KVM test hosts, one row each: the one table the test scripts take their host names, ssh targets, slot and port ranges, classes, roles and defaults from (testvm/test2/t2lib/hosts.py reads it; testvm/hosts.sh is the shell's reader; the scripts find it relative to themselves, here on the Mac and in ~/backotter-work/testvm on the hosts). Order matters: lists keep it, and the first fleet host holds vm-update's fleet lock; a planner's tie between hosts it rates the same goes by class (big first), then heat (the cooler first), then this order (hosts.py tie_key; docs/design/img-speed.md F13, FD2, 2026-11-26), so the first row no longer takes every tie. enabled false: a row reserved for a host that does not exist yet (its name and ranges are taken), which no script treats as a host. default true: a host of every run without --hosts (t2, drive.py); a host joins the defaults only after HostTest2 and one representative per family pass on it (docs/design/test2/design-classes.md); all four amd64 hosts of 2026-11-14 are default since then, copland and cage among them (the big hosts queued for hours while the small ones idled; what only a big host can run is kept there by each cell's ceiling and caps, never by a host's name); czerny joined the defaults 2026-11-19 by the user's choice; choubox joined the defaults 2026-11-17 by the user's choice, with its trial runs waived (the gate's bin cells, holt alpine324, artix-s6, debian13 and netbsd11 and stic mint22 and aerynos had passed there; its two HostTest2 loop cells can never fit its disk ceiling, 3.0 GiB of a 4G RAM disk). slot_range: the host's guest-slot range (guest-slot.sh's slot_range_here; run-all.sh's PORT_BASE is its first port, GUEST_PORTS the range); stic_ports: drive.py's check ports, inside it. ip: an address for when mDNS fails, with host_key_alias the name known_hosts pins it under (null: none known). A host's limits (limits: what each is, and its default) are its row's fields of those names, else class_limits' for its class, else the defaults, the values every host had before; the small class sets stic_slots 2, holt_jobs 1 and base_gib 4 (the user's choice, 2026-11-13); the big hosts keep the defaults but bs2_slots, 5 (small 2); chopin and cinqcent set holt_disk_mode true (the user's choice, 2026-11-14, for vanilla3's 30 GiB disk). RAM first, the SSD for overflow (the user's choice, 2026-11-23): both classes set scratch_mode overflow, so on the six test hosts a HoltTest line works in the RAM disk whenever its reservation fits there now, whatever its size, and on /bkoscratch only when it doesn't (the RAM disk has no room for it now, or it is over the host's RAM-disk ceiling), instead of waiting; no size cutoff (ssd_cutoff_gib, 12, went the same day: every line of 13 to 29 GiB went to a big host's SSD beside an empty RAM disk, and none of t2h-20261123T1713-3cd9's first 17 jobs worked in RAM); slots since 2026-11-23 evening (the user's choice): a host has holt_ram_slots and holt_ssd_slots, 2 and 4 on the big hosts (holt_jobs 4), 1 and 2 on the small ones (holt_jobs 2; choubox's holt_jobs 1 is one job, in either slot); the SSD slots equal holt_jobs since later that evening (the user's choice: with the RAM disks full of SticTest and GuestTest work, 2 and 1 SSD slots would have halved the HoltTest jobs at once; the cost is SSD wear, the memory budget being holt_jobs' as before), so no more RAM jobs at once than RAM slots however much room the RAM disk has, and the slots replace the one-big-line-at-a-time rule in mode overflow (a line starts in a RAM slot only when its D fits the RAM disk right now, so two big ones never wait on each other); with scratch off the RAM disk the memory is the limit, so holt_jobs went from 3 to 4 on the big hosts (4 GiB a job of a 25.2 GiB memory pool that SticTest and GuestTest share, 12 threads, and cinqcent held for swap-out that day) and from 1 to 2 on the M900s (12.1 GiB, 16 threads), choubox keeping its 1 (8.0 GiB, 4 threads); bigfoot's row keeps scratch_mode ram and holt_jobs 1, as it was. To put a host back: "scratch_mode": "ram" in its row (every host: in both classes), then sync. arch: the host's architecture, amd64 or arm64, amd64 when absent (every host before 2026-11-14): a guest runs only on a host of its own (a guest named *-arm64 is arm64, every other amd64; hosts.py guest_arch), and the x86-only loops (bs2, bko-holt shipping, build-round.sh's and promote-bins.sh's default hosts) take only amd64 hosts. job_slice: a systemd slice every heavy job on the host runs in (a guest's QEMU, cmp-run.sh's work), started by hosts.py job_prefix's sudo -n systemd-run --scope --quiet --slice=SLICE -- setpriv --reuid=USER --regid=USER --init-groups --reset-env -- CMD; vm-run and cmp-run.sh do it themselves; absent or null: none. rustup_home, cargo_home: absolute paths, or null (absent: none): the RUSTUP_HOME and CARGO_HOME the host's Rust builds take (hosts.py rust_env; build-round.sh, build-holt.sh and zig-tools.sh export them when unset), for a host whose pinned toolchains live apart from ~/.rustup and ~/.cargo. czerny: a MoreFine M900 like cage and copland (Ryzen 7 H 255, 16 threads, 27 GiB, a 10G RAM disk, host ZFS and bcachefs), enabled 2026-11-19 with cage's roles (build, cache), the small class's limits and its own range 3100-3199; default since 2026-11-19 (the user's choice). choubox: the user's GMKtec NucBox G3 Pro (i3-10110U, 4 threads, 15.5 GiB, 4G RAM disk, ARC capped at 512 MiB; joined 2026-11-17), small class with its own limits (1 stic slot, 1 holt job, 1 bs2 slot, base_gib 3: cmp-run.sh ceiling about 3.0 6.0; max_wall_x 2 since 2026-11-18, its slowness having cost flakes and reruns), cache role only, default since 2026-11-17; cache_skip (vm-store relink: guests a cache host never links, the user's choice 2026-11-25: eight large desktops it could run only on its SATA SSD); it is also the user's fallback bare-metal machine (BackShot-style runs when a distro rejects the Thinkpad), and such a run takes it out of the farm. bigfoot: the ARM64 host (docs/design/arm64.md), the user's daily machine, in bko.slice, its toolchains in /home/m/bko-arm64/toolchains; its one role is build-arm64 (A2: the round's native arm64 rustic-bko and arm64 bko-holt); it has no build, fleet, cache or store-mirror role, and it is also vm-store's master, which only Chopin (bigfoot-link) talks to, by its own name in vm-store (not this row).

classes.big: 62 GiB, a 30G RAM disk (cmp-run.sh ceiling about 23 GiB), host ZFS; build hosts
classes.small: guests from the image cache; copland, cage and czerny (M900s) 27 GiB, a 10G RAM disk, cmp-run.sh ceiling 9.0 10.1; choubox smaller, with its own limits (15.5 GiB, a 4G RAM disk, ceiling about 3.0 6.0)

roles.build: builds a round's binaries (stick/build-round.sh) and bko-holt
roles.build-arm64: builds a round's arm64 rustic-bko natively (stick/build-round.sh --arch arm64) and arm64 bko-holt (build-holt.sh linux-arm64); only an arm64 host has it, and it is not the build role
roles.fleet: holds every guest; vm-update keeps the fleet's copies alike
roles.bigfoot-link: the one host that talks to Bigfoot (vm-store push)

limits.stic_slots: SticTest's checks at once on the host (drive.py --slots); default 3
limits.guest_slots: guest slots drive.py counts on the host's range, 1-3 (check.sh's slot_take 3); default 3
limits.holt_jobs: HoltTest jobs at once on the host (ht1-queue.sh's MAXJOBS); default 3
limits.base_gib: cmp-run.sh's BASE_GIB on the host, GiB kept for the system (BASE_GIB in the environment wins); default 6
limits.holt_disk_mode: true: a holt line over the host's RAM-disk ceiling whose memory fits runs on /bkoscratch (HT_RAM=0, --reserve 0 M; NVMe wear), and placement checks its memory only (not +img: ht1.sh runs it only in the RAM disk); default false
limits.bs2_slots: BackShot2's tier 1 and 2 cases at once on the host (bs2-host queue --slots, each under cmp-run.sh --reserve 2 3), 1-6: the queue's ports are 2943-2948, 2949 a by-hand tier 1's; default 3. big 5: fits cmp-run.sh's memory check (5 x 3 GiB of about 23), unmeasured (2026-11-13); small 2, as bs2 had
limits.max_wall_x: t2's HoltTest2 and GuestTest2 cells a slow host leaves to the others (plan.Planner.fit_wall): a cell whose wall elsewhere (the median of its last 5 measured walls on the other hosts, PASS or FAIL, else its plan estimate) is over max_wall_x times its family's median wall elsewhere is kept off the host while another host of the cell's is left; a number 0.5 to 10, or null; default null (no cap). choubox 2 (the user's choice, 2026-11-18: no cell longer than about twice the median cell on the other hosts lands on the slowest host)
limits.scratch_mode: where a job that can work on either puts its scratch (HoltTest's lines; every other job's is in the RAM disk as ever): ram, in the RAM disk, waiting for its room there; overflow, RAM first: in the RAM disk whenever its reservation fits there now, whatever its size, and on /bkoscratch (cmp-run.sh --reserve-ssd) only when it doesn't, instead of waiting: the RAM disk has no room for it now, or it is over the host's RAM-disk ceiling; ssd, always on /bkoscratch. Never a +img line. A mode other than ram also does what holt_disk_mode does. The wear log says which it was (scratch=ram, scratch=ssd); default ram
limits.ssd_floor_gib: the GiB of /bkoscratch that jobs' scratch never takes: a --reserve-ssd gets its room from the free space above it, less what the other SSD jobs hold, so a host short of free SSD gets no overflow; default 80
limits.holt_ram_slots: with scratch_mode overflow, HoltTest jobs at once on the host whose scratch is in the RAM disk (a RAM slot each); 0 to 16, or null: no cap but holt_jobs; default null. holt_jobs stays the total
limits.heat: how hot the host runs, 0 (cool) to 9, used only to break ties (hosts.py tie_key: class, then heat, then the table's order); default 0. chopin 1: its faulty cooler, and the temperature sampler's medians of 2026-11-24 to 26 (chopin 40.4, cinqcent 35.7 C Tctl), so a tie between the big hosts goes to cinqcent
limits.holt_ssd_slots: the same for jobs whose scratch is on /bkoscratch (an SSD slot each). A HoltTest line takes a RAM slot when one is free and its D fits the RAM disk right now, else an SSD slot when one is free and the SSD has room for its D, else it waits or is left for the other hosts (ht1-queue.sh's place); a +img line takes a RAM slot only. The modes ram and ssd count no slots (holt_jobs alone); overflow with 0 SSD slots is ram, with 0 RAM slots ssd; default null
limits.hot_max: whole degrees C, 50 to 110, or null: heavy work on the host waits while sensors' Tctl is over it, checked before each job (testvm/compare/rustic-exact-round.sh, on the Mac and in the host's jobs); default null (no wait). chopin 95, its weak cooler (until docs/design/img-speed.md F10, 2026-11-27, a wait for Chopin alone, by name)
limits.xz_threads: stick/compress-images.sh's xz -T on the host, 1 to 16 (its own -T wins); default 4 (about 5 GB of memory). chopin 2, its weak cooler (until F10 a hostname check in compress-images.sh)
